paper_title: The State of the Art in Constraining Axion-to-Nucleon Coupling and Non-Newtonian Gravity from Laboratory Experiments
notes: Review/comparison paper by Mostepanenko & Klimchitskaya. It reviews and compares constraints on the axion-to-nucleon coupling g_an (shown as g_an^2/(4pi) vs axion mass in Figs 6, 8, 10) and on Yukawa-type non-Newtonian gravity (Figs 3, 7, 9), obtained from Casimir-force and other laboratory experiments. Every exclusion curve is explicitly reproduced from previously published works (e.g. refs [26,37,69,70,71,72,74] Casimir/Casimir-less experiments; [35] magnetometer K-3He; [36] Cavendish; [38,39] molecular hydrogen; [76] recent Au-SiC Casimir), not derived anew in this paper. The 'proposed'/CANNEX curves (Figs 9,10) are sensitivity projections. The paper reports no new measured exclusion of its own, so is_new_limit=false with no points emitted. Main coupling reviewed is the axion-nucleon coupling g_an (assuming g_an=g_ap).
